packageRules.description: Workspace cross-dependencies are set by lerna during a release, not by Renovate. A PR bumping them would fight the version job and lose.
Dev tooling moves constantly and cannot break a consumer. One grouped PR a week rather than a stream of them.
React and webpack are shared singletons across every micro-frontend on the page. A version change here is a coordination event, so it gets its own PR and a human.
Majors are never grouped — each one is a decision.
